summary: verdaccio-tarball-local-storage preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary in a temp directory, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 728KB Bun-CJS bundle whose top level performs identifier mangling and string-array rotation over a large mixed numeric/string constant table (function `WV8StW` shuffling `n7gIxM`), with no documented relationship to the advertised `@verdaccio/local-storage`-derived functionality. The preinstall loader `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and per-function dictionary-object indirection hiding the platform-detection, download, extract, and exec control flow. The alternate-runtime-dropper shape — fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to execute a bundled, opaque, obfuscated payload outside Node's visibility — combined with obfuscation of both the loader and the payload, indicates an install-time remote code execution vector against any host that runs `npm install` on this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
